label: Vectorisation
description: Trace the image's lines into a connected node/edge graph — colour filter, despeckle, gap-close, spur pruning, simplify, vertex snap, endpoint bridging (T-junctions), ortho straightening and collinear merging. Feeds the Graph nodes. AUTO-TUNE loops these parameters against the image, scores each combo on closed spaces found (minus noise faces and open ends) and bakes the best values back into the sliders — no manual hit-and-trial.
